latHint: Think a group of sheep - not folded clothes.
pivHint: To FOLD laundry is to lay it flat - but a FOLD is also a pen for a what of sheep?
winText: Neatly done. FOLD was the pivot - laundry to a pen holding a FLOCK.
lossText: FLOCK - a group of sheep. FOLD was the pivot: to FOLD laundry and a sheep FOLD.
